<<Concise Cover Letter>>

Dear Google Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Software Engineer position at Google. With a strong background in [specific technology or area, e.g., Python, cloud computing, or machine learning], I am eager to contribute to innovative projects at Google. My experience in [mention relevant experience, e.g., developing scalable systems, working with large datasets, or collaborating on open-source projects] aligns with the values and goals of Google. I would be thrilled to bring my skills and passion to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to Google's mission.

Sincerely,  
[Your Full Name]  
[Your Contact Information]

---

<<Long Cover Letter>>

Dear Hiring Team at Google,

I am excited to apply for the Software Engineer position at Google, and I am eager to contribute to the innovative and impactful work that defines the company. As a software engineer with a deep passion for building scalable, efficient, and user-centric solutions, I am confident that my background and skills align with the mission and culture of Google.

Over the past [X years], I have developed and maintained a range of software systems that support critical business operations. My experience includes working with [specific technologies, e.g., Python, Java, cloud platforms, or machine learning frameworks], and I have consistently delivered high-quality, reliable, and scalable solutions. I have also collaborated with cross-functional teams to design and implement features that enhance user experience and drive business growth.

What excites me most about Google is the opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects that shape the future of technology. I am particularly drawn to Google's focus on innovation, diversity, and the impact of technology on society. I believe that my experience in [mention relevant experience, e.g., system design, data engineering, or AI development] and my commitment to continuous learning make me a strong candidate for this role.

I am eager to bring my skills and enthusiasm to Google's team and contribute to the development of world-class products and services. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background and aspirations align with the goals of Google and how I can support the team's mission.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to contribute to Google's continued success.

Sincerely,  
[Your Full Name]  
[Your Contact Information]  
[LinkedIn Profile or Portfolio, if applicable]
